item.title: EplayerX 1.2.60
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 首页背景、合集封面和部分横图改为从顶部裁切，减少人物头部被裁掉的情况。 - 改善 TMDB 图片缓存复用，减少重复加载。重新打开影片详情时也会复用仍然有效的资料。 - 优化 V2 播放引擎对部分 H.264 视频的转码，以及位图字幕的显示。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。
## What’s New
- Home backgrounds, collection covers, and some landscape artwork now crop from the top to keep faces in view. - Improved TMDB artwork cache reuse to reduce duplicate loads. Reopening a title also reuses details that are still current. - Improved transcoding for some H.264 videos in the V2 playback engine and refined bitmap subtitle rendering.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later.
